But you just can't." - Maree Buscke Maree Buscke warns parents not to assume today's classrooms are the same as the ones they experienced growing up. Are parents too trusting of schools, assuming they no longer need to be involved? Maree Buscke and Penny Marie (Founder of Let Kids Be Kids NZ) discuss concerns around relationship and sex education in schools, including claims that parents may not realise what content is still being taught, the use of third-party resources, transparency around teaching materials, and the importance of parents engaging with schools. 🎥 Watch here: https://rcr.media/episodes/penny-marie-founder-of-let-kids-be-kids-nz-parents-urged-to-look-beyond-curriculum-changes #RCRMedia

youtube.title: David Seymour defends the India Free Trade Agreement.
youtube.summary: “We’ve got sheep meat, honey, wine, technology… there’s so much opportunity. And we get to sell all these things to them, instead of being beholden to China. That’s the real story that may have been missed here. And then you’ve had all this stuff about immigration. The reality is that if you add up all the visas that are allowed for Indian nationals under this Agreement, they add up to 6% of the number of visas that were issued to Indian nationals last year anyway”. RCR’s Tane Webster spoke with Deputy Prime Minister and ACT Leader David Seymour.
